capabilities: Rename multiple files at once using existing/new character patterns
Rename or move files matching a folder location or a set of tags
Match file names with a regex pattern and flags
Preview pending renames before applying them
Update references to renamed files across the vault
extras: The installation section mistakenly refers to installing the Tasks plugin; no screenshots or worked examples are included.
intentEvidence: Under the hood this plugin is using obsidian API for renaming, but we just applying it for many files
motivation: The author stored daily notes as 2022_01_01 but another platform preferred dashes, and found existing guides required running scripts.
problem: Obsidian renames one file at a time, so renaming many files usually requires external scripts in Python or Node.js.
summary: Bulk rename tool that renames many files from a pattern or regex and updates all references across the vault.
